title: Curse
text:
Curses are Debuffs that apply a certain downside on the recipient, weakening them. By default, the player can apply a maximum of one Curse on an enemy, which can be increased. Curse skills can only apply the curse on enemies within a certain monster level, which increases with gem level.


== Special Interactions ==
All curses create Runic Inscriptions.
